ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

2. When practising Listening for Gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Fluency.

4. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.

5. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

6. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.

7. When practising Phonological Awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness.

8. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

9. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Aloud: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Reading: Library Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
